FROM policy AS p
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN insurable_object AS io
  ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier = pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier

  ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336;

WITH coverage_premiums AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Effective_Date AS coverage_start_date,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium
  FROM policy p
  JOIN policy_amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  JOIN premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
  GROUP BY pa.Effective_Date
),
premiums_with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    coverage_start_date,
    annual_premium,
    LAG(annual_premium) OVER (ORDER BY coverage_start_date) AS previous_annual_premium
  FROM coverage_premiums
)
SELECT
  coverage_start_date,
  annual_premium,
  100.0 * (annual_premium - previous_annual_premium)
    / NULLIF(previous_annual_premium, 0) AS premium_percentage_change
FROM premiums_with_previous
ORDER BY coverage_start_date;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-5 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles > 15 THEN 'more than 15 miles'
  END AS distance_band,
  COUNT(*) AS claim_count,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Nearest_Firestation_miles IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY
  CASE distance_band
    WHEN '0-5 miles' THEN 1
    WHEN '6-10 miles' THEN 2
    WHEN '11-15 miles' THEN 3
    WHEN 'more than 15 miles' THEN 4
  END;

SELECT
  CONCAT(CAST(FLOOR(Year_Built / 10) * 10 AS INTEGER), 's') AS build_decade,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS claim_count
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Year_Built IS NOT NULL
  AND Loss_Ratio IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY FLOOR(Year_Built / 10) * 10
ORDER BY FLOOR(Year_Built / 10) * 10;

SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(Fireplace) = 'yes' THEN Loss_Ratio END)
  - AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(Fireplace) = 'no' THEN Loss_Ratio END) AS average_loss_ratio_difference
FROM fire_claim;

SELECT corr(Number_of_Firefighters, Loss_Ratio) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM fire_claim;

WITH premiums_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    pcd.Effective_Date AS period_start_date,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium
  FROM policy p
  JOIN policy_amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  JOIN premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
  WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
  GROUP BY pcd.Effective_Date
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY period_start_date) AS first_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY period_start_date DESC) AS last_rank
  FROM premiums_by_period
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN first_rank = 1 THEN period_start_date END) AS first_period_start,
    MAX(CASE WHEN first_rank = 1 THEN annual_premium END) AS first_annual_premium,
    MAX(CASE WHEN last_rank = 1 THEN period_start_date END) AS last_period_start,
    MAX(CASE WHEN last_rank = 1 THEN annual_premium END) AS last_annual_premium
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  POWER(
    last_annual_premium / NULLIF(first_annual_premium, 0),
    1.0 / NULLIF(DATE_DIFF('year', first_period_start, last_period_start), 0)
  ) - 1 AS compound_annual_growth_rate
FROM endpoints;

SELECT
  Number_of_Firefighters,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
GROUP BY Number_of_Firefighters
ORDER BY average_loss_ratio ASC
LIMIT 1;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  date_diff('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Open_Date) AS days_incident_to_open,
  date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS days_open_to_close,
  100.0 * date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)
    / NULLIF(date_diff('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date), 0)
    AS percent_of_total_time_open
FROM claim AS c
JOIN occurrences AS o
  ON o.Occurrence_Identifier = c.Occurrence_Identifier;

WITH incurred_losses AS (
  SELECT SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_incurred_losses
  FROM claim c
  JOIN claim_amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.Claim_Open_Date) = 2019
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_payment lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_reserve lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
      )
    )
),
earned_premium AS (
  SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM premium p
  JOIN policy_amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pcd.Effective_Date) = 2019
)
SELECT
  total_incurred_losses / NULLIF(total_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred_losses
CROSS JOIN earned_premium;

WITH claim_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
               OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
             THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_loss,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
               OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
             THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
  FROM claim_amount ca
  LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  cl.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
  COALESCE(ct.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
  COALESCE(ct.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  100.0 * COALESCE(ct.total_expense, 0) / NULLIF(ct.total_loss, 0) AS expense_percentage_of_loss
FROM claim cl
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat
  ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = cl.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_totals ct
  ON ct.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
      THEN ca.Claim_Amount
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) / NULLIF(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
          OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        THEN ca.Claim_Amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    0
  ) AS paid_to_reserved_ratio
FROM claim AS c
LEFT JOIN claim_amount AS ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_payment AS lp
  ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_payment AS ep
  ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserve AS lr
  ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_reserve AS er
  ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier;

WITH coverage_premiums AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
    pa.Effective_Date,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY
    pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
    pa.Effective_Date
),
coverage_losses AS (
  SELECT
    cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
    cc.Effective_Date,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
  FROM claim_coverage cc
  JOIN claim_amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loss_payment lp
    WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loss_reserve lr
    WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
  GROUP BY
    cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
    cc.Effective_Date
)
SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  pcd.Effective_Date AS coverage_start_date,
  COALESCE(cp.premium, 0) AS premium,
  COALESCE(cl.incurred_loss, 0) AS incurred_loss,
  COALESCE(cl.incurred_loss, 0) / NULLIF(cp.premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM policy_coverage_detail pcd
JOIN policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
  ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
LEFT JOIN coverage_premiums cp
  ON cp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND cp.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
LEFT JOIN coverage_losses cl
  ON cl.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND cl.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
GROUP BY
  p.Policy_Number,
  pcd.Effective_Date,
  cp.premium,
  cl.incurred_loss;

WITH agent_policies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
    p.First_Name,
    p.Last_Name,
    pol.Policy_Identifier
  FROM agreement_party_role AS apr
  JOIN agreement AS a
    ON a.Product_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
  JOIN policy AS pol
    ON pol.Policy_Identifier = a.Product_Identifier
  JOIN person AS p
    ON p.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  WHERE LOWER(apr.Party_Role_Code) = 'agent'
),
policy_premiums AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier,
    pa.Policy_Amount
  FROM policy_amount AS pa
  JOIN premium AS pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
),
policy_losses AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pcd.Policy_Identifier,
    ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier,
    ca.Claim_Amount
  FROM policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
  JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
  JOIN claim_amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN loss_payment AS lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
)
SELECT
  ap.First_Name,
  ap.Last_Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ap.Policy_Identifier) AS distinct_policies_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT pp.Policy_Amount), 0) AS total_premium,
  COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT pl.Claim_Amount), 0) AS total_loss_paid
FROM agent_policies AS ap
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums AS pp
  ON pp.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_losses AS pl
  ON pl.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY ap.agent_id, ap.First_Name, ap.Last_Name
ORDER BY ap.Last_Name, ap.First_Name;

WITH claim_costs AS (
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
),
claims_by_zip AS (
  SELECT
    la.Postal_Code,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Claim_Open_Date,
    c.Claim_Close_Date
  FROM claim c
  JOIN insurable_object io
    ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier = c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
  JOIN geographic_location gl
    ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
  JOIN location_address la
    ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
),
costs_by_claim AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_claim_cost
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN claim_costs cc
    ON cc.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  cbz.Postal_Code AS zip_code,
  SUM(COALESCE(cbc.total_claim_cost, 0)) AS total_claim_cost,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', cbz.Claim_Open_Date, cbz.Claim_Close_Date)) AS average_days_open_to_close
FROM claims_by_zip cbz
LEFT JOIN costs_by_claim cbc
  ON cbc.Claim_Identifier = cbz.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cbz.Postal_Code
ORDER BY cbz.Postal_Code;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  pe.First_Name,
  pe.Last_Name,
  SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium,
  COUNT(DISTINCT (pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, pcd.Effective_Date)) AS coverage_period_count,
  AVG(pa.Policy_Amount) AS average_premium_per_coverage_period
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement a
  ON a.Product_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN agreement_party_role apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = a.Agreement_Type_Code
JOIN party_role pr
  ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN person pe
  ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_amount pa
  ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
 AND pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN premium pm
  ON pm.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name = 'Policy Holder'
GROUP BY pe.First_Name, pe.Last_Name;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  date_diff('day', a.End_Date, p.Effective_Date) AS days_between_assessment_end_and_policy_effective_date,
  pe.First_Name AS underwriter_first_name,
  pe.Last_Name AS underwriter_last_name,
  ar.Assessment_Result_Type_Code AS assessment_result
FROM policy AS p
JOIN agreement_assessment AS aa
  ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN assessment AS a
  ON a.Assessment_Identifier = aa.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN assessment_result AS ar
  ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN underwriting_assessment AS ua
  ON ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier = ar.Assessment_Result_Identifier
JOIN assesment_party_role AS apr
  ON apr.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN party_role AS pr
  ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN person AS pe
  ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name = 'Underwriter';

SELECT
  c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  c.Catastrophe_Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cl.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS total_loss_paid,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS total_loss_reserved,
  100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0)
    / NULLIF(
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0)
        + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0),
        0
      ) AS paid_share_of_incurred_loss_percentage
FROM catastrophe AS c
JOIN claim AS cl
  ON cl.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amount AS ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_payment AS lp
  ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserve AS lr
  ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
  c.Catastrophe_Identifier,

WITH incurred_loss AS (
  SELECT
    c.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
  FROM claim c
  JOIN claim_amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
  )
  GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
property_premium AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium p
    ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier
)
SELECT
  la.Line_1_Address AS street_address,
  il.incurred_loss,
  pp.total_premium,
  il.incurred_loss / NULLIF(pp.total_premium, 0) AS incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio
FROM incurred_loss il
JOIN property_premium pp
  ON pp.Insurable_Object_Identifier = il.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN insurable_object io
  ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier = il.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN geographic_location gl
  ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN location_address la
  ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
ORDER BY incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio DESC;
